title: impl verify passes without the tests the plan named ever being written
desc:
tests[].target in sdd.json is never checked. "A regression test must fail without the fix; check that it does" exists only as prose in implement-change SKILL.md -- policy in a prompt, not in code.

ACCEPTANCE:
- impl verify fails (exit 7) when a tests[].target is neither changed in the diff nor an existing file the plan marks as edited, naming each missing target
- wb status shows the missing targets under verify
- optional --regression mode: with non-test changes stashed, the regression targets must fail; with them restored, pass; the result is recorded in evidence.json
- regression tests for each rule
